# Luna Maze — Full Architecture & Product Specification

Luna Maze is an independent technology and design studio dedicated to high-craft digital instruments.

## 1. Studio Identity & Overview
- **Name**: Luna Maze
- **Type**: Independent Product Studio
- **Founder**: Thehan (Founder & Principal Engineer)
- **Primary Domain**: https://lunamaze.com
- **Philosophy**: "Cognition, focus, and craft. Founder-led. Considered. Quiet on purpose."

## 2. Product Portfolio

### AXIOM (Porn Addiction Recovery & Neuroplasticity Companion)
- **URL**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/
- **Platforms**: iOS (TestFlight / App Store), Android
- **Core Technology**: Local SQLite, client-side cryptographic keystore, zero-knowledge architecture.
- **Scientific Foundation**: Neuroplasticity, Dopamine D2 receptor upregulation timelines, prefrontal cortex executive control restoration, deltaFosB half-life clearance models.
- **Features**:
  - Encrypted personal reflection journal.
  - Somatic breath-pacing and urge interception.
  - Neuroplasticity milestone tracking without shame or gamification streaks.
  - Companion tools: Severity Assessment, Rewire Timeline Calculator, Panic SOS Mode, Typographic Wallpapers, Evidence-Based Recovery FAQ (https://lunamaze.com/axiom/faq/).

### Tether ADB (Windows Android Device Manager)
- **URL**: https://lunamaze.com/tether-adb/
- **Platforms**: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
- **Features**:
  - QR Code Wireless ADB Pairing (Android 11+ pairing port negotiation).
  - High-framerate screen mirroring with audio forwarding (powered by integrated scrcpy).
  - Live color-coded Logcat streaming with regex filtering.
  - Direct ADB terminal shell.
  - APK drag-and-drop batch installer and storage file browser.
  - Portable, self-contained binary distribution with ADB and scrcpy bundled.

### TypeCrt (Zero-Latency CRT Typing Test)
- **URL**: https://lunamaze.com/typecrt/ | Live Application: https://typecrt.in
- **Platforms**: Modern Web Browsers
- **Tech Stack**: Pure TypeScript, zero-dependency event loop processing, Canvas/WebGL CRT scanline shaders.
- **Features**:
  - Sub-millisecond input response time.
  - 50+ hand-tuned retro terminal themes.
  - Adaptive weak-key practice algorithm.
  - Command palette (`Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K`) for keyboard-first navigation.
  - Detailed keystroke velocity and error clustering analytics.

### Drift (Handcrafted Precision Puzzle Game)
- **URL**: https://lunamaze.com/drift/
- **Status**: Closed Beta Testing
- **Description**: A minimalist precision puzzle game exploring momentum, spatial anticipation, and calm aesthetics.
